title.en: Limit theorems, concentration, and Monte Carlo
title.zh: 极限定理、集中不等式与蒙特卡洛方法

lead.en: Prove moment bounds and a weak law, qualify CLT and Hoeffding statements, calculate sample sizes, and report Monte Carlo uncertainty with the actual independent sampling units.
lead.zh: 证明矩界和弱大数法则，限定 CLT 与 Hoeffding 条件，计算样本量，并按实际独立单位报告蒙特卡洛不确定性。

prerequisites.en: Modules 04 and 23. Continuous integral alternatives require Module 17; the CS branch uses finite events. All three labs use only the Python standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 04、23。连续积分替代需模块 17；CS 分支使用有限事件。三个实验仅需 Python 标准库。

en: Calculate mean variation with independent and dependent sampling units.
Prove Markov and Chebyshev with thresholds and moments stated.
Derive the finite-variance weak law and interpret convergence in probability.
State the IID CLT without claiming universal finite-sample accuracy.
Apply bounded independent Hoeffding and finite-family union sample sizes.
Report Monte Carlo uncertainty and derive a qualified common-random-number comparison.
zh: 按独立及依赖抽样单位计算均值波动。
列阈值与矩条件，证明 Markov 和切比雪夫。
推有限方差弱法则并解释依概率收敛。
陈述 IID CLT，不声称通用有限样本精度。
应用有界独立 Hoeffding 及有限族并集样本量。
报告蒙特卡洛不确定性，推带条件共同随机数比较。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and prove the moment inequalities.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并证明矩不等式。
阅读均值方差弱法则条件。

text.en: Retrieve covariance terms and probability quantifiers.
text.zh: 检索协方差项与概率量词。

title.en: Weak law CLT and sampling shapes
title.zh: 弱法则、CLT 与抽样形状

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and distinguish their limit statements.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，区分极限结论。

text.en: Compare repeated fair and rare Bernoulli means.
text.zh: 比较公平及罕见 Bernoulli 重复均值。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore exact tails and bounds.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索精确尾概率与界。

text.en: Report a finite event or optional integral with distinct uncertainty quantities.
text.zh: 用不同不确定性量报告有限事件或选学积分。

title.zh: 依赖、种子与带条件保证

text.en: Diagnose copied streams and compare paired randomness.
text.zh: 诊断复制流并比较配对随机数。

text.en: Complete choices and write an uncertainty contract.
text.zh: 完成选择题并写不确定性约定。

text.en: Read CLT and bounded-concentration theorem scopes.
text.zh: 阅读 CLT 与有界集中定理范围。

text.en: Complete the exit task and audit sampling assumptions.
text.zh: 完成结业并核查抽样条件。
